reread: Emma Lou finished rinsing out some silk stockings and sat down in a chair to reread a letter she had received from home that morning.
That sounds like an innocent occupation, but Cohn had read and reread “The Purple Land.

I read and reread her letter, and some softened feelings stole into my heart and dared to whisper paradisiacal dreams of love and joy; but the apple was already eaten, and the angel’s arm bared to drive me from all hope.
rer: HENRY—Yes, and she used to draw pictures of it in the style of Dürer—almost morbid—and later it caught a disease and died——
